section: Section 1: Global System Navigation, Login & Attendance Rules (All Staff) — 1. Authentication & Automatic Attendance Logging (/login)
text: [Section: Section 1: Global System Navigation, Login & Attendance Rules (All Staff) — 1. Authentication & Automatic Attendance Logging (/login)] ● Access Procedure: Open your web browser and navigate to the secure access route / login. Enter your assigned corporate credentials (email and password). ● Automatic Shift Clock-In: Upon successful authentication, the system automatically inserts a clock_in timestamp into the attendance_records table for the current IST work date. Simultaneously, an active session registry entry is generated inside user_session_logs. ● Shift Compliance Timings: The official operating window is strictly enforced between 09:30 AM and 06:30 PM IST. ● Late Threshold Rules: Any authentication timestamp executed after 09:30:00 AM IST triggers an automated LATE flag on the daily record and increments the employee's monthly cumulative late counter by 1 unit.

section: Section 1: Global System Navigation, Login & Attendance Rules (All Staff) — 2. Tab-Close Auto-Logout & Presence Guard
text: [Section: Section 1: Global System Navigation, Login & Attendance Rules (All Staff) — 2. Tab-Close Auto-Logout & Presence Guard] ● Session Lifetime Policy: To prevent unauthorized workplace session hijacking, browser tabs run an active session ping. Closing the active browser tab or window immediately revokes the session context, executes a system logout, and writes a TAB_CLOSED shutdown event to the employee's HR Dossier. ● Page Refresh Protection: Refreshing the active browser window (F5 or Ctrl+R / Cmd+R) does not trigger a session teardown. The system validates active sessionStorage security tokens to preserve continuity without interrupting workflow.

section: Section 1: Global System Navigation, Login & Attendance Rules (All Staff) — 3. Global Navigation & Command Palette
text: [Section: Section 1: Global System Navigation, Login & Attendance Rules (All Staff) — 3. Global Navigation & Command Palette] ● Enterprise Sidebar: Toggle the collapsible left navigation bar to navigate to authorized departmental suites based on your system role. ● Global Project Switcher: Use the top header dropdown to change your current active project context instantly. ● Global Command Palette: Press Ctrl + K (Windows) or Cmd + K (macOS) from any screen to open the universal command modal. Type keywords to quickly execute cross- departmental navigation, open active tasks, or jump to project dossiers. ● Daily Tasks Modal (/api/tasks/daily): Access your personal task list by clicking the task icon in the top header bar to inspect assigned deliverables, check off completed subtasks, and track daily operational targets.

section: Section 2: Human Resources (HR) & Administration (/hr, /admin) — 1. Employee Management (/api/hr/create-user, /api/hr/delete-user)
text: [Section: Section 2: Human Resources (HR) & Administration (/hr, /admin) — 1. Employee Management (/api/hr/create-user, /api/hr/delete-user)] ● Onboarding Process: Access /hr and click Add Employee. Fill out the AddEmployeeModal form with full name, corporate email address, base salary details, and role assignments. ● Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Assign explicit permissions selecting from: super_admin | executive | hr | finance | architect | designer | site_engineer | procurement ● Offboarding Process: Open the employee profile inside /hr and trigger RemoveEmployeeModal. This revokes system permissions, revokes active OAuth tokens, and flags the profile as inactive while keeping past historical logs intact for audit requirements.

section: Section 2: Human Resources (HR) & Administration (/hr, /admin) — 4. Multi-Tier Leave Approval & Delegation Workflow (ApplyLeaveModal, LeaveDetailsModal)
text: [Section: Section 2: Human Resources (HR) & Administration (/hr, /admin) — 4. Multi-Tier Leave Approval & Delegation Workflow (ApplyLeaveModal, LeaveDetailsModal)] ● Step 1 (Submission): The applicant submits an application selecting leave parameters, an approving manager (designated_approver_id), and a delegated colleague (delegated_person_id) to manage active tasks. ● Step 2 (Automated Verification): The system checks attendance_records and existing leave logs for the selected delegated person. If that colleague is scheduled to be absent or on leave during that timeframe, the system blocks submission with a clear error prompt. ● Step 3 (Dual Sign-Off): Upon submission, the request enters status PENDING_DESIGNATED. Following approval by the assigned manager, it updates to PENDING_HR for final HR execution. Once confirmed, the status updates to APPROVED.

section: Section 2: Human Resources (HR) & Administration (/hr, /admin) — 5. Bulk Data Operations (/admin, /api/admin/csv-import)
text: [Section: Section 2: Human Resources (HR) & Administration (/hr, /admin) — 5. section: Section 3: Site Engineering & Daily Site Reports (/site, /dsr) — 1. Submitting a Multi-Photo Daily Site Report (/dsr)
text: [Section: Section 3: Site Engineering & Daily Site Reports (/site, /dsr) — 1. Submitting a Multi-Photo Daily Site Report (/dsr)] ● Form Parameters: Select the active project name, pick the Update Priority Level (Low, Normal, High, Urgent, Critical), and enter details for completed work, labor count, material usage, and site remarks. ● Multi-Photo Drag & Drop Upload Engine: a. Select or drag multiple high-resolution progress photos into the upload dropzone. b. The system builds an immediate client-side thumbnail preview grid. c. Hover over thumbnails and click the X button to discard accidental or blurry shots. d. Upon form submission, the system uploads images concurrently, populating the photo_urls array on the DSR record.

section: Section 3: Site Engineering & Daily Site Reports (/site, /dsr) — 2. Logging Site Blockers (/api/webhooks/blocker)
text: [Section: Section 3: Site Engineering & Daily Site Reports (/site, /dsr) — 2. Logging Site Blockers (/api/webhooks/blocker)] ● Triggering Critical Blocker Alerts: If site issues halt progress (e.g., material shortfalls, structural issues, or missing drawings), click Raise Blocker on the site dashboard. ● System Escalation: Setting a blocker to Urgent or Critical triggers a system-wide action: ○ Fires a webhook payload to /api/webhooks/blocker. ○ Sends an immediate pop-up notification to the CEO Notification Center. ○ Promotes the underlying project to the top spot on the Executive Dashboard.

section: Section 6: Quick Troubleshooting & FAQ for Staff
text: [Section: Section 6: Quick Troubleshooting & FAQ for Staff] Scenario / Error Message Root Cause Analysis Operational Solution "I closed my browser tab and got logged out." Expected security behavior. Operating policy forces session shutdown on window close. Re-open browser, navigate to / login, and enter credentials to establish a new entry in user_session_logs. Scenario / Error Message Root Cause Analysis Operational Solution "I cannot delegate my leave to a colleague." Validation failure. Target colleague is marked absent or has pending/approved leave for those dates. Choose an active colleague who is scheduled to be present during your leave window. "My project update isn't at the top of the CEO Dashboard." Project updates sort based on priority level before sorting by date.

section: Section 6: Quick Troubleshooting & FAQ for Staff
text: [Section: Section 6: Quick Troubleshooting & FAQ for Staff] Verify the priority tag assigned to your update. Items set to Critical and Urgent automatically display above Normal or Low entries. "Multiple photos aren't attaching in DSR." Files were uploaded individually or unsupported formats were attached. Select all images concurrently in the file window or drag them together directly into the upload area before submitting the report. "Command Palette (Ctrl+K) is not opening." Focus is currently inside an active text input or native browser overlay. Click outside active text fields on the main window background and press Ctrl + K (Windows) or Cmd + K (macOS). "Clock-In time registered as LATE unexpectedly." Auth timestamp occurred at or after 09:30:01 AM IST. Ensure you complete your login sequence prior to 09:30:00 AM IST to avoid late tags on attendance records.
